rationale: The task introduces a new Codex default prompt and therefore may change product semantics or user-visible behavior. The supplied evidence contains no approved durable UR, completed Brownfield Review, or evidenced Mode/Slice Decision. AGDF must fail closed rather than preselect a delivery path.
decision_grounds: This is a new change intent in an existing AGDF repository, so gate-check is the default entry point.
New product semantics, functional changes, or user-visible behavior require an approved durable UR before routing.
No exact Approval: UR and corresponding durable UR artefact are evidenced.
No completed Brownfield Review with scope reason and evidence is provided.
No recorded Mode/Slice Decision selects quick_task, verified_change, structured_slice, or structured_delivery.
compact_delivery cannot be selected because approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick_task context (i
., the persisted quick_task Mode/Slice Decision) are not evidenced.
